subject: Math 1st Paper
question: $\begin{bmatrix}x+4 & 2\\4x & 6\end{bmatrix}$ = 0, x-এর মান কত?
explanation: $\begin{aligned} & \left|\begin{array}{cc}x+4 & 2 \\ 4 x & 6\end{array}\right|=0 \\ & \text { বা, } 6(x+4)-4 x=2=0 \\ & \text { বা, } 6 x+24-8 x=0 \\ & \text { বা, } 2 x=24 \\ & \therefore x=12 \text {. }\end{aligned}$

subject: Math 1st Paper
question: $\int_{0}^{\frac{\pi}{2}}cos^{2}$ 2x dx এর মান কত?
explanation: $\begin{aligned} \frac{1}{2} \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}} 2 \cos ^2 2 x d x & =\frac{1}{2} \int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}(1+\cos 4 x) d x \\ & =\frac{1}{2}\left\{[x]_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}+\left[\frac{\sin 4 x}{4}\right]_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\right\}=\frac{1}{2} \times \frac{\pi}{4}=\frac{\pi}{8}\end{aligned}$
